general_information.Description: Description: This course is designed to introduce students to properties of foods and changes that occur during preparation. Students will learn basic skills in food preparation and presentation while implementing food safety and sanitation standards. Topics to be covered include prevention of food-borne illness through proper handling of potentially hazardous foods, food safety management, GMP procedures, legal guidelines, kitchen safety, facility sanitation, and guidelines for safe food preparation, storing, and reheating... The program also includes a visit 3-4 restaurants or food production lines. The course also introduces Vietnamese regulations on food and beverage safety.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

description: Description: This course is designed to introduce students to properties of foods and changes that occur during preparation. Students will learn basic skills in food preparation and presentation while implementing food safety and sanitation standards. Topics to be covered include prevention of food-borne illness through proper handling of potentially hazardous foods, food safety management, GMP procedures, legal guidelines, kitchen safety, facility sanitation, and guidelines for safe food preparation, storing, and reheating... The program also includes a visit 3-4 restaurants or food production lines. The course also introduces Vietnamese regulations on food and beverage safety.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Differentiate between the various types of food-borne illnesses
Describe the food preparation procedures and methods used to prevent food-borne disease outbreaks
Identify the proper receiving, storage and cooking temperatures
Explain the laws and regulation governing the layout and design of commercial kitchens in relation to food safety
Identify the proper procedures in cleaning and sanitizing food contact surfaces
Observe and evaluate the quality of food served by catering establishments
Demonstrate the ability to work independently as well as the ability to cooperate when working in groups
Demonstrate a diligent, serious attitude during class and a professional attitude during field sessions

assessments.Grading Guide: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments.

A group of four or five students will write a review report on restaurants during the field trip, in which (1) describe the restaurants' operation; (2)based on the learned knowledge, give an evaluation for each stage of food processing, from the food suppy to storage, preservation , processing and delivering to customers; (3)make a comparison of standards and performance betweent the kitchens; (4) suggest changes and future directions for each kitchen. OR (5) come up with an idea for a dream kitchen/restaurant. Detailed requirements are specified by the instructor. (Evaluation will be based on both presentation and written report (recommended 50%, 50% accordingly
assessments.Note: The report should be typed and double-spaced with 11-point font, and be submitted in soft or hard copy. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission.
